owner_posts.post_text:
Many women with PCOS in Andheri West, Mumbai struggle with weight gain, fatigue, and frequent cravings, especially while managing long work hours and daily travel. A common issue is skipping meals or depending on quick snacks between meetings, thinking it will help with weight loss.
In reality, irregular eating patterns can worsen PCOS symptoms. Skipped meals often lead to unstable blood sugar levels, low energy, and strong cravings later in the day. Over time, this can increase insulin resistance and make hormonal imbalance more difficult to manage.
Effective PCOS management is not about eating less, but about eating balanced meals. When a meal includes adequate protein, fibre-rich vegetables, and the right carbohydrates, blood sugar levels remain more stable. This supports hormonal balance, improves energy levels, and reduces frequent hunger and cravings.
For many working women with PCOS, this simple shift in how meals are structured leads to better focus, improved stamina, and more sustainable weight control. Balanced eating fits into everyday routines and supports long-term PCOS health rather than short-term restriction.
Small, consistent changes in daily meals can play a meaningful role in managing PCOS symptoms and overall hormonal health.

featured_reviews.name: Deepan Betal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hi, I had gone to Deepa Nandy’s Nutriguide after a devastating diagnosis of a chronic inflammatory disease (autoimmune) called Ankylosing Spondylitis which had been causing me severe SI joint, ankle and feet pain for some months. Little did I know back then that this decision of mine to take her consultancy would help me more than any medication or doctor could. When I went to Deepa Mam it was due to the fact I was severely overweight (130 kg bodyweight, 43% body fat) and managing the symptoms of this flare-up required me to reduce my body fat. After my diagnosis in January my medications began a few weeks later, delayed due to some medical difficulties. Initially after some improvement the relief fell completely stagnant. This time in my life was so bad it was inexplicable. There were a good 3-4 months where I had to use a walking stick just to walk at home and a good amount of time I used a walker as well. Make note although I was overweight, I was into competitive powerlifting so this phase of my life was shattering my confidence. This tunnel seemed to have no light at the end of it or so I thought. After months of trying all sorts of medications to almost no avail so much so there was a time, I was popping 10-12 pills a day even after suffering from severe cramps all across due to them.
Then after putting off the most beneficial thing for me, I decided to finally think outside of medicines and into my diet. I went to Deepa mam around end June for the first time since my predicament began. Keeping in mind till now I had looked into all possible avenues I could find online to improve my condition. After looking and assessing my condition she took some time. In about 2-3 days she came to me after researching and looking into multiple resources and figured out a diet for me. It was a low FODMAP diet which she figured out specialized for my condition. This led to cutting off of many foods which were causing my gut harm and aggravating my condition. These food items which I restricted were nowhere mentioned by my multiple doctors thus far. Me being a research student myself got me interested at this, from which I understood how fundamental my problem was and how remarkably Deepa Mam was able to obtain a connection between my condition and how a diet can help. Calling the diet helpful would not be enough to describe what it did to cure me and became like a light at the end of a long dark tunnel.
My ESR and CRP (both inflationary parameters determining how active the disease is in me) dropped to almost half within 3 weeks which were not decreasing actually increasing after months of medication. The best part was I was not losing strength as my diet consisted of all required macro and micro nutrients but reduced my excess body fat at an accelerated rate with no loss in strength or muscles. From 130 kg and 43% body fat to 102 kg at 30% body fat all this from August to December just 5 months of following Deepa Mam’s diet. I was back doing all the physical activities I love got back a sense of self after loosing it due to my inability and inaction because of my condition. All these and a reduction in the dosage and requirement of various harmful medications given due to my condition by rheumatologists.
From having to use assistance to do my daily tasks and a walker to just move around to being able to walk and stretch and get back slowly to do all the things I love and finally get back to college I would credit Deepa Mam for giving me my life back.

featured_reviews.name: Rutuja Morkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been working with Deepa Kenney, for the past 6 months, and I can confidently say this has been a life-changing journey for me.

What makes Deepa truly exceptional is her focus on sustainable, balanced nutrition rather than quick fixes. She taught me how to build a proper meal with the right balance of protein, carbohydrates, and fiber—simple combinations like sprouts, vegetables, and roti that keep you full, energized, and away from unhealthy cravings.

One of the biggest mindset shifts she gave me was this: you don’t have to starve to lose weight. In fact, she encourages eating well and even eating more—as long as it’s healthy. That removed all the fear around food and made the journey feel natural and enjoyable.

Her dedication is unmatched—she never misses a single day to check in and guide you. That level of consistency keeps you accountable and makes you feel supported every step of the way.

She also teaches patience, which is so important. There were weeks when my weight didn’t move, but she kept me focused and positive. Over time, I started understanding my body better, including how my weight fluctuates during my cycle. With her guidance, I stayed consistent—and the results followed.

The day I saw 145 pounds on the scale after three months was an unforgettable moment. I was so happy and emotional, and Deepa played a huge role in that achievement. She celebrates your wins, but also knows when to be strict and bring you back on track when needed.

Beyond weight loss, she instills discipline and long-term healthy habits—which, honestly, is even more valuable. I’ve made better choices like switching to ragi and jowar roti, and even felt confident enough to try Navaratri fasting for the first time.

Sometimes even a simple salad now keeps me full and energized—something I never thought possible before this journey.

If you’re looking for someone who genuinely cares, stays committed to your success, and transforms not just your weight but your mindset and lifestyle, I highly recommend Deepa. This journey has made me healthier, more disciplined, and truly happy. Thanks Deepa.

featured_reviews.name: Asselen de Sousa
featured_reviews.review_text:
Since adolescence, I have faced multiple health challenges and spent years trying different ways to lose weight, gyms, strict diets, and countless plans. Each time, whatever little progress I made would vanish, and the weight would return even more. Eventually, I surrendered and stopped trying.
It was during this phase that God led me to Deepa through a friend. I was hesitant at first, but after just one conversation with her, I felt a deep sense of peace and clarity, and I knew I was meant to begin this journey.
Through Deepa’s guidance, I learned that weight loss is not about punishment or deprivation. Instead, it is about honoring the body God has lovingly created. She helped me reconnect with my body and trust the wisdom God has already placed within it.
When I began in June 2025, I weighed nearly 80 kg. By January 2026, I had come down to 66 kg and moved from an XXL to a Medium. This journey has been joyful, sustainable, and deeply healing—unlike anything I had experienced before.
By God’s grace, my thyroid medication dosage was reduced to half, something I had struggled with since the time of my diagnosis. This felt like a true blessing and affirmation that healing was taking place from within.
Today, I feel confident and at peace. Mindful eating has become a natural habit, not a struggle. I am deeply grateful to God for this transformation and for placing the right guidance in my life at the right time. This journey has been nothing short of a blessing.
